invented.quote: Subject: Three office days a week from September 1, 2027
invented.why: The brief gives the date as 'September 1' without specifying the year 2027.

invented.quote: From September 1, 2027, everyone at the firm will work in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.
invented.why: The brief specifies 'September 1' as the start date, but does not state the year is 2027.

invented.quote: For the past few years the partners have come in one day a week.
invented.why: The brief states that the partners have been coming in one day a week, but does not specify that this has been for 'the past few years'.

invented.quote: You can keep working remotely until the end of 2027.
invented.why: The brief says they can work remotely until 'the end of next year', which contradicts the 2027 start date invented earlier in the document and is an invented year.

invented.quote: From January 2028, we'll ask you to come in one day a week.
invented.why: The brief says 'After that, they come in once a week' following the end of next year, without specifying the year 2028.
